∀ {envelope : Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveInvocationClaim.Capacity} {m : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveWorkAccount.Meter}, (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveWorkAccount.Meter.start envelope).Reaches m → m.source ≤ envelope.replayBytes ∧ m.core ≤ envelope.coreBytes ∧ m.replayBytes = envelope.replayBytes ∧ m.coreBytes = envelope.coreBytes
Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveWorkAccount.Meter → Prop := fun m => m.source ≤ m.replayBytes ∧ m.core ≤ m.coreBytes

∀ {m m' : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveWorkAccount.Meter} {source core : ℕ}, m.draw source core = Except.ok m' → m'.replayBytes = m.replayBytes ∧ m'.coreBytes = m.coreBytes ∧ m'.draws = m.draws ++ [(source, core)] ∧ m'.Within

∀ {m : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveWorkAccount.Meter} {source core : ℕ} {stage : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveWorkAccount.Stage} {needed left : ℕ}, m.draw source core = Except.error (stage, needed, left) → stage = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveWorkAccount.Stage.frontEnd ∧ needed = source ∧ left = m.replayBytes - m.source ∧ m.replayBytes < m.source + source ∨ stage = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveWorkAccount.Stage.core ∧ needed = core ∧ left = m.coreBytes - m.core ∧ m.coreBytes < m.core + core
